start.greeting: Hello. I'm {bot_name} — an AI assistant for psychological self-help and emotional support.
start.capabilities:
I can help you:
— understand emotions and thoughts
— reduce stress
— do CBT/DBT/mindfulness exercises
— keep a mood diary
— make a small action plan
start.disclaimer: I am not a doctor, not a psychotherapist and not a crisis service. I do not diagnose or prescribe treatment.
start.crisis_warning: If you are in danger or have thoughts of harming yourself/others, contact emergency services, a crisis line or someone nearby.
start.consent: By continuing, you confirm that you understand these limitations.

crisis.response:
It seems like this might be an unsafe moment. I cannot replace emergency help, but I can stay with you in chat.

Please do 3 things now:
1. Call your local emergency service or crisis line.
2. Text or call someone nearby: "I'm not safe alone right now, stay with me."
3. Put away anything you could hurt yourself with.

Reply with one word: are you alone right now?
crisis.elevated:
I hear that you're going through a very difficult time. This is important and serious.

I can help with small steps right now, but if you've been feeling bad for a long time or it's getting worse, please reach out to a specialist.

Would you like to do a short stabilization exercise?

mood.question: 📊 How are you feeling right now?

chat.prompt: I'm here. Tell me what's on your mind. I'll listen and help you figure it out.
chat.error: Sorry, an error occurred while processing your request. Please try again later or reach out for help.

safety_plan.title: 📋 Safety Plan
items: 2. What I can do myself in the first 10 minutes: _____________
safety_plan.start_filling: Start filling in any item. No need to do everything at once.

privacy.policy:
🔒 Privacy Policy

• We minimize data collection
• Messages are not stored by default (STORE_CONVERSATIONS=false)
• You can delete your data with /delete_my_data
• We do not share data with third parties
privacy.delete_confirm: ⚠️ Are you sure you want to delete all your data? This action cannot be undone.
privacy.deleted: ✅ All your data has been deleted.
